# DCH round 5 guard-removal table

Source head: `198a28e67da8770ea346ef65e6f4786ee220cc30`. **6,113 guards / 17,430 negatives / 19,059 direct cases.** Zero unproved negatives, guards without flipping witnesses or mutation exceptions. Native execution is NOT_RUN.

All 7,031 frozen raw constraints in the 34 owned schemas remain covered by 5,998 declared logical schema guards and 4,923 frozen one-change witnesses. The remaining rows prove function and preflight rules. No schema or frozen witness was changed in round 5.

The same direct cases run in the ordinary checker. Function predicates are replaced only in memory and restored per row. Pure-schema rejection certificates and deterministic unreached-guard baselines retain the exact rejected complement; every reached potentially admitting removal is evaluated. U is the entire negative ID set in DCH-guard-negative-index.json; every row gives its exact complement.

Named duplicate sets: identifier pattern/length/format; required fixed edition and scope tags; closed payload copies; archive constants/predecessors; test kind/code/evidence; checkpoint consumer/projector constants and joins; the same recursive exact-type predicate at materialization, history, archive, test and checkpoint call sites. The physical pointer pair is `len(body_bytes(pointer)) <= INLINE_LIMIT` plus equality to its exact SP-337 reference object: the latter implies the former. Only those copies of the same fact are removed together.

The missing-generation row (formerly G0836) substitutes only `source.generation_lookup_witness`, the independent accepted generation, and continues every remaining checkpoint join. It never returns success at the lookup branch. All 51 withdrawn-state/last-event/publication containment controls still refuse. A separate 102-assertion campaign also restores the real generation and confirms the same defects still refuse.

Retry availability types are proved by removing the real `type(available) is not bool` AST predicate, without replacing its input. Null payload types are proved directly at the exact-type boundary; separate positive controls verify that materialization still reports null as unavailable. These two checks are reported separately because None is the materializer's unavailable sentinel.
